units.title: do/make/have — три «делательных» глагола
units.shortDescription: do homework, make mistakes, have fun — устойчивые сочетания.
units.theoryHtml:
do — выполнять деятельность/работу: do homework, do the dishes, do exercise, do business, do someone a favour, do your best. make — создавать/производить результат: make mistakes, make a decision, make a phone call, make money, make friends, make noise, make the bed. have — получать опыт/действовать: have breakfast, have fun, have a shower, have a rest, have an accident, have a look.

domakehave
do the shoppingmake a cakehave dinner
do a testmake planshave a talk
do sportsmake progresshave a good time

⚠ Частые ошибки русскоговорящих: make a photo → take a photo / take a picture. make a party → have/throw a party. do a mistake → make a mistake. make homework → do homework.

Мини-диалог:
— What did you do today? — I did some shopping and made dinner.
— Did you have time to make that call? — Yes, and I didn't make a single mistake in the contract!

exercises.prompt: I need to ___ my homework before dinner.
Try not to ___ the same mistake twice.
Let's ___ a break.
She ___ a lot of money in real estate.
Can you ___ me a favour?
We need to ___ a decision today.
I ___ a shower every morning.
exercises.explanation: have a shower (или take a shower в амер.).

exercises.prompt: They ___ a lot of noise last night.
Don't forget to ___ ___ (сделай фото) of the documents.
We're ___ ___ (устраиваем вечеринку) on Saturday.

units.title: Глагол get: get up, get tired, get home
units.shortDescription: Самый многозначный глагол английского — пять главных значений.
units.theoryHtml:
get — универсальный глагол. Пять главных значений:

ЗначениеПример
получатьget a letter, get a job, get paid
становиться (+ прил.)get tired, get old, get better, get dark
добиратьсяget home, get to work, get here
фразовые: движениеget up (вставать), get in (в машину), get off (выйти из транспорта)
получить результатget a present, get wet, get lost

get + прил. — аналог become: It's getting cold. get to + место: How do you get to the station? НО: get home/get here (без to!).

⚠ Частые ошибки: get to home → get home. get up early vs get on well (ладить) — разные фразовые глаголы. И have got ≠ get.

Мини-диалог:
— How do you get to work? — By metro. I get up at six and get there by eight.
— Aren't you getting tired? — I got used to it long ago.

exercises.prompt: I ___ up at 7 a.m. every day.
It's ___ dark outside.
How do you ___ to the airport?
We ___ home very late last night.
She ___ a letter from her aunt.
We ___ lost in the old town.
___ the bus at the next stop.
The soup is ___ cold. (становится)
I need to ___ ___ (встать) earlier.
They ___ (ладят) on well with their neighbours.

units.title: Неправильные глаголы: топ-40 и как их учить
units.shortDescription: go-went-gone: самые нужные формы и самые путаемые пары.
units.theoryHtml:
Неправильные глаголы меняют форму прошедшего времени и причастия: go — went — gone. Их нужно выучить. Топ-список:

basepastpast participle
bewas/werebeen
havehadhad
dodiddone
gowentgone
saysaidsaid
getgotgot/gotten
makemademade
knowknewknown
taketooktaken
seesawseen
comecamecome
thinkthoughtthought
findfoundfound
givegavegiven
telltoldtold
becomebecamebecome
leaveleftleft
feelfeltfelt
putputput
bringbroughtbrought

⚠ Путаемые пары: lie (лежать) — lay — lain vs lie (врать) — lied — lied; bring (приносить) vs take (уносить); learn — learnt/learned (оба верны). И drink — drank — drunk (порядок похожих гласных).

Мини-диалог:
— Where did you go? — I went to the bank, but it was closed. I've never seen it closed before!
— Have you taken your keys? — Yes, I brought them.

exercises.prompt: Yesterday I ___ to the gym.
She has never ___ sushi before.
He ___ me about the party.
I've ___ my keys somewhere.
They ___ the film last night.
The book was ___ by my aunt. (написана)
He ___ his wallet on the table.
I ___ your message an hour ago.
Have you ___ (взял) my umbrella? (take)
She ___ (купила) a new dress yesterday. (buy)
